name: TheDawn

components.pose: Fast, spiralling ascent: she rises upright through the centre of a great updraft with her body turning gently in the spiral, arms out and lifted as if on the wind, head lifted and gaze to the camera, joyful and free; full figure from head to toe visible.
components.headwear: a {{METAL}} circlet with a pair of swept-back feather wings at the temples
components.jewelry: a {{METAL}} feather collar with {{GEM}} stones, long feather earrings, {{METAL}} armlets
components.legs_feet: bare feet, floating clear of the stone
components.effects: A great spiral of wind lifts leaves, feathers and silk ribbons in a swirling column around her, streaks of {{MAGIC}} light tracing the air currents, clouds swept back from her.

notes: THE DAWN: the sister rising from the Sundering in her element's homeland - first look at her territory. Her dragon is not yet bound, so no companion; native creatures instead. Rise speed and energy differ per sister.
